new_value: Hoisted explicit drop_id canonical/uniqueness validation above evict_for_space in add_drop (rust/lichen-client/src/deaddrop.rs): a doomed request (non-canonical or duplicate ID) now returns None before any eviction, per spec 18.9 (eviction admits a stored drop, never fires on doomed requests).
